about: Checksums that tie the committed evidence of the paid confirmation of the Job study2_calculate_redesign to the raw run folder kept outside the repository. bundleChecksum is the runner's checksum over the bundle's file list (study/harness/runner.py, write_bundle); bundleJsonSha256, the sums-file digest and the evidence-file digests are SHA-256 of the exact bytes as the run and the worker wrote them (LF). No archive zip was made: the run folder stays read-only in the machine-local results folder, with a per-file sums file beside it.
